title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1213: Big furball and grandstar (3)

section.p: At the same time.
A certain stone statue was taking a tour around the Allheaven Battlefield.

He did not approach the Eastrift Valley. Nor did he approach the main human realm entrance. Curious about the current state of the world, Grandstar had been roaming all over. Every now and then, he would stop to reminisce about the past.
He had deliberately avoided the Eastrift Valley as he could smell the danger there. Too many Invincibles had gathered there.

With several human experts on the verge of dao affirmation, the humans had deployed almost all their Invincibles. The myriad races had also sent numerous Invincibles over. This was most likely the largest ever number of humans attempting dao affirmation at the same time.
In fact, the humans weren’t the only ones who would be attempting dao affirmation. Some among the myriad races were preparing to do the same.

Some of the experts from the minor races were trying to take advantage of this opportunity when those from the major races were distracted. One could say that the dao affirmation of Xia Longwu was a golden opportunity for everyone else to attempt their dao affirmations.

The stone statue was unbothered. The quarrel between them had nothing to do with him. He would only act to take Su Yu back. That kid was currently madly absorbing death qi. That was unwise. What if he accidentally opened a connection to the Death Realm inside the Human Realm?
That was his mayor. A very important mayor he didn’t want to lose.
But he had to find a safe point of entry. The few known points of entry couldn’t be used as they were under constant watch.
“Human realm entrance…”
He roamed the eastern sector for a long time and searched according to his memories. Before long, he appeared above a mountain. When he arrived, he muttered, “Heavenly King Range. Is this the place?”

Things had changed so he was unsure if this was the same place. Back then, the source qi density here was exceptionally thick. And there was supposed to be a tiny realm entrance leading to the Human Realm here.
He wondered if the entrance was still around.
That entrance had quite a unique history behind it. Recalling the history, Grandstar looked around and spoke through a special frequency, “Is the Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor here?”

Yes. The Soul Devourer Realm was supposed to be nearby as well. But he didn’t know the exact location. He only knew that this small entrance was related to the Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor. He could only hope that this was still the same Pseudo Emperor from back then.

According to the stories, this entrance was a secret entrance jointly built by the Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor and an old friend of his. The two of them were too lazy to take the main entrance so they made a side entrance to serve as a shortcut in and out of the Human Realm.
Initially, very few people knew about this. Eventually, it was exposed. It was said that the Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor had received a scolding for this.
As Grandstar thought of the past, many ancient memories resurfaced in his mind.
Right at that moment.
Soul Devourer Realm.
Under a massive heavenly source fruit tree, a big furball opened his eyes lazily. A voice resounded in his ears, “Is the Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor here?”
The big furball yawned and sank into contemplation.
Was this a dream?
Why had he been dreaming so much recently?
But as he contemplated, the same voice rang out again.
“Is the Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor here?”
The sleepy big furball looked at the sky. His gaze penetrated the void to land on a stone statue.
That was quite a familiar-looking stone statue. After staring at the stone statue for a while, the big furball soared into the sky.
Moments later, he appeared outside the realm. Or it would be accurate to say that he floated out of the realm.
Meanwhile, Grandstar was just about to look for the entrance himself when his heart skipped a beat. When he turned around, he was greeted with a pair of big eyes.
He hurriedly stepped back. But when he finally got a good look at the full body of the newcomer, he exhaled in relief and said, “Greetings, Pseudo Emperor.”
He paid close attention, but he couldn’t determine if this was the same Pseudo Emperor from back then.
All the furballs looked the same. Since he wasn’t from this race, it wouldn’t be so easy for him to tell one from the other.
“Which stone are you?”
The big furball was quite confused as well. All these stone statues looked the same. Which one was this?
“Grandstar.”
“Ohh…” The big furball yawned again and asked, “Why are you looking for me?”
“Lord Pseudo Emperor, is there an entrance to the Human Realm here?”
“Yes.”
“Then…”
He was cut off by the big furball who seemed to have recalled something, “Have we met before?”
Left somewhat speechless, Grandstar answered, “Not long ago, you rewinded time and met me once.”
“Ohhhh! So that wasn’t a dream?” The big furball said, “I was wondering why I kept dreaming of all these chunky rocks recently.”
Grandstar didn’t know what to say.
The big furball asked, “Why are you here?”

“I have a business to handle in the Human Realm.” Grandstar explained, “Do you remember the human your offspring is following around? He’s now my mayor. I’m worried that he would accidentally open a connection to the Death Realm in the Human Realm. That would be very troublesome.”
“Ohhh…” After a long delay, the big furball replied, “Is he a pseudo death spirit now?”
“Yes.”
The big furball thought about it and asked, “Pseudo death spirit…who converted him?”
“Xing Yue.”
“Who’s Xing Yue?”
That wasn’t someone the big furball knew.
“You met her before as well. She was there when you rewound time previously.”

“Ohh…that death sovereign…” The big furball nodded. After yet another long delay, he said, “Go, then. The Human Realm…try not to stay too long. That might trigger a connection to the Death Realm. Did you transfer all your death qi to that human lad?”
“Yes.”
The big furball thought about it and said, “Tell him to not stay too long. It’s very troublesome if a connection forms…”
He yawned and asked, “What’s happening over there? Why are there so many Eternals?”
“A fight.”
Grandstar gave a short reply. He knew that the big furball was referring to the Eastrift Valley.
“Ohhh…”
A fight?
Did they not have anything better to do?
How boring.
After yawning yet again, the big furball muttered, “I’m feeling quite hungry. How long has it been since my last meal?”
“If my memory serves right, it has been a few hundred years since your last meal.”
“Is that so?” The big furball was unsure. He mumbled, “Did I grab a meal a few hundred years ago? Why can’t I remember doing that? I’m so hungry…so it has been a few hundred years?”
Why couldn’t he remember his previous meal? How odd. Grandstar was left quite speechless. This Pseudo Emperor…was quite a forgetful one.
“Have you forgotten, Lord? A few hundred years ago, a human Eternal and a divine Eternal were fighting. You ate the sea of willpower of that divine.”
“I don’t remember doing that…”
The big furball mumbled doubtfully, “I don’t eat seas of willpower. I only eat characters. Was that…my wife? Did she leave?”
The big furball then ripped the space behind him apart and took a peak inside his realm. After a while, he yawned and said, “Huh? So she’s really away. I wasn’t aware.”
Grandstar was completely stunned. That…wasn’t this guy?
That was his wife? Holy shit! His wife had casually eaten an Eternal with a single bite?

He also took the chance to sneak a glimpse into the big furball’s realm. When he saw the gigantic heavenly source fruit tree, he was rendered speechless. So this tree was still around? How many years had it been? This tree was probably old enough to be forged into a divine weapon.
While Grandstar was staring at the tree, the big furball turned around and asked, “Why are you staring at my home?”
Grandstar didn’t know what to say. He wasn’t staring. He was only catching a glimpse.

The big furball did not appear worried that his wife was gone. Instead, he muttered curiously, “Where is she? Don’t tell me she’s going after that immortal. I only mentioned the yummy characters of that guy once. Is she trying to eat without me?”
Grandstar exclaimed, “She’s trying to eat the Pseudo Emperor of the immortals?”
This family had quite a strong appetite.

The big furball shook his entire body and said, “I don’t know. Tiangu is still alive. He sure is good at staying alive. Someone as old as him definitely has yummy characters. I have been longing after his characters since back when he was a Skysoar…”

Holy shit! So this was really the same furball from back then. Grandstar was finally certain. If this guy had been around since Tiangu was still a Skysoar, this was definitely the same furball from back then. Why was this guy grumbling that Tiangu was good at staying alive? This guy was pretty good at staying alive as well!
Not only that, this guy had even gotten himself a wife and a son at such an old age. How impressive.
The big furball muttered curiously, “My wife is missing. Should I go looking? Tiangu’s characters are very yummy…I really want to eat them…”
Grandstar took the chance to instigate the big furball, “Go, Lord Pseudo Emperor. The characters won’t be yummy anymore if he dies of old age.”
That made a lot of sense. The big furball nodded with his entire body. Should he go and take a look? The flavor of the characters would change if Tiangu ended up dying.
“Fine. I’ll take a look. You…watch over the lad from my family…”
“Yes, yes. Lord, can you open the realm entrance for me? Your little lad is in the Human Realm…”
The big furball was gone, but a realm entrance had indeed appeared.
Looking at the spatial undulations in front of him, Grandstar grimaced. Was the big furball really going after Tiangu? Did he do something wrong? Would chaos befall the immortals?
Wait, why did he even care? That had nothing to do with him.
The soul devourers were the ones who would be doing the eating, not him. That old freak wouldn’t die so easily anyway.
Speaking of, were these three the only soul devourers in existence?
Why did it feel like they were on the verge of extinction?
Soon, Grandstar tossed the matter out of his mind and strode into the realm entrance. It was time for an adventure in the Human Realm.
